GAP LE AoA/AoD Connectionless Transmitter Exported Functions

group GAP_LE_AOX_CONNLESS_TRANSMITTER_Exported_Functions

Functions

T_GAP_CAUSE le_aox_connless_transmitter_init(uint8_t adv_set_num)

Initialize the number of advertising sets for connectionless transmitter.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause = le_aox_connless_transmitter_init(adv_set_num);
}

参数:

adv_set_num -- [in] Advertising sets number.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Operation success.

  • Others -- Operation failure.

返回:

Operation result.

T_GAP_CAUSE le_aox_connless_transmitter_set_cte_transmit_params(uint8_t adv_handle, uint8_t cte_length, T_GAP_AOX_CONNLESS_TRANSMITTER_CTE_TYPES cte_type, uint8_t cte_count, uint8_t switching_pattern_length, uint8_t *p_antenna_ids)

Request the Controller to set parameters for the transmission of Constant Tone Extensions in periodic advertising.

If sending request operation is successful, the setting result will be returned by the callback function registered by le_register_aox_cb with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_AOX_CONNLESS_TRANSMITTER_SET_CTE_TRANSMIT_PARAMS.

This function can be called after Bluetooth Host is ready.

Explanation: If Bluetooth Host is ready, the application will be notified by message GAP_MSG_LE_DEV_STATE_CHANGE with new_state about gap_init_state which is configured as GAP_INIT_STATE_STACK_READY.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause = le_aox_connless_transmitter_set_cte_transmit_params(adv_handle, cte_length, cte_type, cte_count, switching_pattern_length, p_antenna_ids);
}

T_APP_RESULT app_gap_aox_callback(uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)
{
    T_APP_RESULT result = APP_RESULT_SUCCESS;
    T_LE_AOX_CB_DATA *p_data = (T_LE_AOX_CB_DATA *)p_cb_data;

    ......
    switch (cb_type)
    {
    case GAP_MSG_LE_AOX_CONNLESS_TRANSMITTER_SET_CTE_TRANSMIT_PARAMS:
        {
            APP_PRINT_INFO2("GAP_MSG_LE_AOX_CONNLESS_TRANSMITTER_SET_CTE_TRANSMIT_PARAMS: cause 0x%x, adv_handle 0x%x",
                            p_data->p_le_aox_connless_transmitter_set_cte_transmit_params_rsp->cause,
                            p_data->p_le_aox_connless_transmitter_set_cte_transmit_params_rsp->adv_handle);
        }
        break;
    ......
}

参数:

  • adv_handle -- [in] Used to identify an advertising set.

  • cte_length -- [in] Constant Tone Extension length in 8 μs units. Range: 0x02 to max_cte_length supported by Controller returned by le_aox_read_antenna_information.

  • cte_type -- [in] T_GAP_AOX_CONNLESS_TRANSMITTER_CTE_TYPES.

  • cte_count -- [in] The number of Constant Tone Extensions to transmit in each periodic advertising interval. Range: 0x01 to 0x10.

  • switching_pattern_length -- [in] The number of Antenna IDs in the pattern. Range: 0x02 to max_switching_pattern_length supported by Controller returned by le_aox_read_antenna_information.

  • p_antenna_ids -- [in] Antenna ID in the pattern.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • Others -- Sending request operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending request.

T_GAP_CAUSE le_aox_connless_transmitter_set_cte_transmit_enable(uint8_t adv_handle, uint8_t cte_enable)

Request the Controller to enable or disable the use of Constant Tone Extensions in periodic advertising.

If sending request operation is successful, the enabling or disabling result will be returned by the callback function by le_register_aox_cb with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_AOX_CONNLESS_TRANSMITTER_STATE_CHANGE_INFO.

This function can be called after Bluetooth Host is ready.

Explanation: If Bluetooth Host is ready, the application will be notified by message GAP_MSG_LE_DEV_STATE_CHANGE with new_state about gap_init_state which is configured as GAP_INIT_STATE_STACK_READY.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause = le_aox_connless_transmitter_set_cte_transmit_enable(adv_handle, cte_enable);
}

    T_APP_RESULT result = APP_RESULT_SUCCESS;
    T_LE_AOX_CB_DATA *p_data = (T_LE_AOX_CB_DATA *)p_cb_data;

参数:

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Sending request operation is successful.
